idea: The site is one Admiralty chart: magenta course line sails section to section onto waypoints. Repeatable in a sentence. Loses a point because the hero itself is still headline plus photo.
hierarchy: Phone fold reads H1 first at 52px, then photo; desktop H1 124px against 21px lede. Links are clearly secondary but View work is modest for a primary action.
copy: Fidelity step clean against all 128 lines of the previous site. Only additions: chart position and the Night label.
craft: Hover, focus, copy, boot skip and reduced motion verified by 17 behaviour checks. Course line lands exactly on waypoints at 1280 to 1920; simple leg below 1280.
brand: Tokens only; magenta reserved for navigation as on a chart. No brand pack exists to check against.
fit: Recomposed at 390 and 320: soundings to 2 columns, dedicated phone screenshots, timeline stacks. Recruiter path is one tap to work, CV and email.
truth: 13 claims in the ledger pass. Twelve are checked against Russell's own copy, not independently; position checked against Wikipedia. Live totals replace figures once deployed.
distinctiveness: Three decisions: magenta restricted to navigation following chart convention; figures and dates set as italic soundings; Day and Night palettes taken from chart displays with a course line drawn into waypoints. All five SLOP tests pass, the boot is the most familiar move left.
load: 857 words and about 10 screens on desktop. Kept deliberately because the brief forbids losing content, but it is long.
